metadata.title: Global AI Ecosystem: Multipolar Interdependence
metadata.purpose: Source-grounded data model for visualizing AI sovereignty, chokepoints and cross-border dependencies.
metadata.audit_purpose: Make each disputed numeric claim independently auditable from a primary source.
change_summary: Added a uniform national capability stack to every ecosystem.
Expanded Israel with energy, data centers, local cloud regions, Nimbus, AI21, Intel Israel and NVIDIA Israel.
Expanded the United States with domestic energy/data-center infrastructure and semiconductor manufacturing.
Separated physical location, ownership, operation, jurisdiction and supply-chain control.
Added Tower Semiconductor Fab 2 as an operational specialty-foundry capability and marked Fab 1 production discontinued.
Added Israel AI data-center planning and grid-connection constraint nodes.
Added explicit validation for legislative thresholds and conflicting hearing metrics.
Refined AI21 origin, headquarters and unverified-control fields.
build_notes: Applies reviewed source-audit corrections from Sprints 1–3.
Adds Tower Semiconductor specialty fabrication, AI data-center planning and grid-connection constraints.
Keeps Government Decision 4255 at corroborated policy-direction status while the full official text remains pending.
Separates legislative thresholds, connected capacity, requested capacity and operational infrastructure.

methodology.core_principle: No country is treated as the center by default.
methodology.future_commitments: Must be visually separated from operational capacity.

claim_classes.observed: Directly stated in a primary source.
claim_classes.observed_aggregate: Primary sources support the aggregate relationship, without asserting every company-level edge.
claim_classes.observed_plus_inference: Observed facts plus an explicit analytical interpretation.
claim_classes.analytical_inference: Analytical relationship, shown with a dotted edge.

strategic_dependency_score.warning: This score is an analytical visualization score, not an externally published metric.

capability_model.principle: A capability located inside a country is not automatically sovereign. Physical location, ownership, operation, legal jurisdiction and supply-chain control are modeled separately.
capability_model.local_cloud_rule: A local hyperscaler region is classified as foreign-owned locally hosted. It improves latency, resilience and data residency, but does not by itself constitute full national control.
capability_model.fabrication_rule: A foreign-owned fab operating locally is a domestic capability with limited national ownership and external technology dependencies.
capability_model.missing_layer_rule: Every ecosystem must contain an explicit record for every capability layer, even when the status is import_dependent, absent or research_required.

private_company_control_policy.principle: Company origin and headquarters must not be treated as proof of current ownership or control.
private_company_control_policy.strict_domestic_control_requirement: A private company may be classified as domestically controlled only when a suitable corporate, regulatory or securities source supports that conclusion.
private_company_control_policy.fallback: Use private_company_control_unverified and expose the evidence gap.

validation_rules: Every numeric metric must reference at least one source_id.
Every edge must include status, claim_class, confidence and source_ids.
Announced or committed capacity must not be displayed as operational capacity.
Company valuation must not determine node size.
No direct mineral-to-company arrow is allowed unless a source establishes a specific dependency.
Analytical inferences must use a dotted edge and cannot be presented as disclosed agreements.
Ownership, equity investment, cloud purchase, hardware deployment and technology partnership must use separate edge categories.
Before publication, verify that every source URL resolves and every date is on or before metadata.as_of.
An exact numeric claim must be supported by a source that states that exact number.
A letter of intent must be labeled separately from a definitive contract or operational capacity.
Private-company post-money valuation must be labeled as such and must not be presented as market capitalization.
Every high-value contract claim should prefer a regulator or securities filing when one is available.
The default visualization must hide financing valuations unless the selected view is explicitly financial.
Every ecosystem must contain exactly one capability_stack entry for every capability layer.
No ecosystem may be rendered with only a policy node when operational or commercial capabilities are known.
Every national capability node must separate physical location, operator, ownership countries and jurisdictions.
A foreign-owned locally hosted cloud region must not be labeled fully sovereign.
Planned manufacturing or HBM capacity must not be displayed as operational.
Every non-source and non-end-use node should have at least one incoming or outgoing relationship.
Aggregate nodes must identify their member nodes through aggregate_membership edges.
A private-company origin or headquarters country must not be treated as verified national control.
A secondary strategic-analysis source may frame policy questions but cannot independently support current operational, ownership or investment metrics.
An aggregate national semiconductor node must not imply control of the complete global semiconductor supply chain.
Energy-resource availability must be distinguished from storage resilience and data-center grid readiness.
Specialty semiconductor fabrication must not be visualized as leading-edge AI accelerator fabrication unless the source explicitly supports it.
Legislative thresholds must not be presented as operational facility capacity.
Hearing-reported metrics must retain speaker or institution attribution until the underlying primary presentation is archived.
Conflicting grid-connection metrics must be displayed as unresolved dated observations rather than silently replaced.
A private company's country of origin or headquarters must not populate verified_control_country.
known_limitations: Official company announcements may describe conditional commitments rather than completed deployment.
The graph is selective and does not include every supplier, model provider or national program.
Ecosystem-level dependency statements may combine sourced observations with clearly marked analysis.
Private-company valuations are included only as dated context and are excluded from node weighting.
Israeli data-center grid metrics are currently based on attributed Knesset hearing summaries rather than archived regulator presentations.
No current national primary-source metric has yet been identified for AI data-center water, cooling, backup-generation or fuel-continuity constraints.
